name: meetstream
description: Build tracks: 1) the Recording bot (AI meeting bots for Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams: record, transcribe and summarize calls, post-call or real-time transcription, auto-join from your calendar); 2) the Bridge server (agents in the meeting on your own stack, with free local models or your harness's model); 3) the hosted Agents API (voice agents: MeetStream's default keys or your own keys; LiveKit and local agents coming soon) - over the hosted MeetStream MCP server and the meetstream CLI.
